binders: An arbitrary profile profile : Real -> Real and arbitrary real speed.
hypotheses: For the second conjunct only, profile is differentiable at every real point.
conclusions: For every x,t, w(x+speed*t,t)=profile(x), where w(x,t)=profile(x-speed*t).
If profile is globally differentiable, w satisfies the pointwise transport equation w_t+speed*w_x=0 for every x,t.
mathematical_definitions: The global transport predicate universally quantifies x,t and at each point existentially witnesses both partial derivatives and their zero residual.
translation.proposition_plain_english: Every translated profile w(x,t)=profile(x-speed*t) is exactly constant along the characteristic x+speed*t. If the profile is differentiable everywhere, this traveling profile has pointwise time and space derivatives everywhere and satisfies w_t+speed*w_x=0.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: No sign or nonzero condition is imposed on speed.
The PDE conclusion is conditional on global differentiability of the profile; the unconditional first conjunct is only an algebraic characteristic identity.
The theorem concerns this constructed traveling profile, not all solutions, and states no uniqueness, initial-value well-posedness, or boundary behavior.
